claims.claim_text: The indexed Charles Morley is a high-confidence match to the historian who served as an OSS research analyst in 1943-44.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact name appears in the OSS index and two independent professional or institutional obituaries describing his OSS research-analyst service.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the distinctive exact name, matching OSS role, dates, education, and mutually consistent institutional sources.
claims.temporal_assessment: The sources place OSS service in 1943-44 and the Ohio State appointment in 1944.
claims.match_notes: The match does not depend on a namesake or postwar career alone; both obituaries explicitly identify OSS service.

claims.temporal_assessment: Documented prewar employment; the source does not identify which of the three teaching posts was immediately prior to OSS.
claims.match_notes: The university is treated as an employer because the source says he taught there; no last-civilian or immediate flag is assigned.
